title: Model Paper 2
html:
MODEL PAPER 2 — MECEE-BL (Group I). Time: 3 hours. Full marks: 200. Attempt all questions. Each question has four options with one best answer; choose the best and mark it on your answer grid.

Each correct answer carries 1 mark and each wrong answer deducts 0.25 mark. Calculators are not allowed; do rough work in the margins. Sit this paper in one uninterrupted sitting, exactly as on the day.

How to score yourself: score = (number correct) − 0.25 × (number wrong). Do not leave blanks — in this marking scheme even a blind guess is worth +1/16 of a mark. Record your correct/wrong/blank counts per subject before you open the key.

This paper follows the official unit weightage exactly:

3.6 Answer key and explanations

Answers — Zoology (1–40)

1. (d) — One ancestral finch radiated into many beak forms for different niches.

2. (a) — The appendix is a reduced remnant of a once-functional caecum.

3. (a) — Lamarck proposed that acquired characters are inherited.

4. (b) — Cnidoblasts hold the stinging nematocysts of coelenterates.

5. (a) — The pearl oyster Pinctada secretes nacre around an irritant.

6. (c) — The sea horse is a true bony fish; the others are not fish at all.

7. (b) — The platypus is a monotreme that lays eggs yet suckles its young.

8. (d) — Tendons join muscle to bone (ligaments join bone to bone).

9. (c) — Osteocytes are the mature cells embedded in bone matrix.

10. (c) — Many-layered squamous epithelium protects the skin surface.
